_comment: Light with NO sign -> the LIGHT sigil's default manifestation: a little puff of firework sparks plus a few end-rod sparks, with a transient light block parked at the origin for the puff's duration. Fires whenever a bare light sigil is closed in a ring (no carrier sign). Particles are fully data-driven (see LightEffect / ParticleSupport); count scales with Size x stack.
